title: One canvas for AI-accelerated ideation across 2D, 3D & AR | Vectary Canvas
markdown:
Introducing **Vectary Canvas**, a new space for AI-accelerated ideation. → [Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/canvas/)

Vectary Canvas Beta

# Design process, reinvented

One collaborative canvas for research, ideation, concept development, and validation across **2D, 3D, and AR**, powered by AI and built for invention.

[Start creating](https://www.vectary.com/signup/?next=/dashboard/)

From first spark to finished concept

## A creative flow that stays in one place

Start with everything that inspires the idea, explore more directions with AI, develop the strongest concepts in 3D, and validate them together in context.

Research

## Start designing with the full picture in view

Bring in sketches, photos, references, documents, and 3D models to see every source of inspiration and information together as you begin exploring different directions.

![Mouse concept board with input shape, materials, recolor, and shape variations in Vectary Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/canvas-workflow-research.jpg)

Explore

## Find the right concept without endless prompting

Use purpose-built AI presets to test forms, finishes, layouts, and variations as ideas evolve. Explore more directions while staying in control of how each one develops, until you find the concept you want to take further.

![Shape exploration board with mouse design variations in Vectary Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/canvas-workflow-explore.jpg)

Refine

## Turn promising ideas into 3D concepts you can keep developing

Use 3D to guide each concept and bring the strongest one closer to a finished design. Edit geometry, materials, lighting, and models without interrupting your workflow or switching tools.

![Refining AETHER CORE mouse with materials, 3D print test, and final render in Vectary Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/canvas-workflow-refine.jpg)

Validate

## Evaluate concepts in context and make decisions with fewer assumptions

Compare options side by side, gather feedback directly alongside the work, and use AR to evaluate concepts in their real-world context while the design can still change.

![Validating AETHER CORE mouse colorways, AR preview, and team feedback in Vectary Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/canvas-workflow-validate.jpg)

## More control at every step with hundreds of presets

Each ready-made preset is fine-tuned for a specific creative task, helping guide AI toward the result you have in mind. No perfect prompt required.

### Purpose-built for design tasks

Develop an idea step by step with presets focused on the task at hand. Extract, apply, and explore materials. Transform sketches or basic 3D models into photorealistic visuals, generate 3D from 2D, replace selected objects, adapt lighting, extract a pose, clear an interior, and much more. Combine presets as your idea evolves, so you can explore directions without losing momentum.

![Custom presets shaped around a product workflow](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/custom-preset.jpg)

### Custom presets shaped around your workflow

Need something more specific? Vectary can create custom presets tailored to your processes, products, and visual language. For teams with advanced needs, the ability to create and manage their own presets is coming soon.

## One collaborative space to develop ideas

Brainstorm visually, iterate in real time, and refine concepts as a team. Let feedback shape ideas while they are still evolving.

[Try Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/signup/?next=/dashboard/)

![Collaborative TACTIQ Buckle Canvas board with materials, renders, and team feedback](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/canvas-collab-board.jpg)
